description: A benefit plan which describes the payments for a given period. Multiple plans can be available on a coverage. For example if indexation takes place each year, you will get a seperate plan for each year.

amount.description: The amount to be disbursed. In case of a one time payment, it is the full amount to be disbursed. In the other cases it is the yearly amount.

ends_after.description: The end date of the payment. In case the date lies a day BEFORE the start date, this line is annulled. In case of an one time payment, the date is the same as the start date. In case of a temporary payment period, this date is the date is the last date of the payment period. In case an amount changes on a later date, the date can stay as it was.

reason.description: The reason for the benefit plan

starts_on.description: Date of the start of the payment period.
